current_difficulty_reason: The nonvanishing of the Zhu image is not a formal consequence of the associated graded invariant ring, whose singular arc-polynomials can have positive depth. The author combines the commutative highest-weight reduction with a carefully chosen PBW monomial and an explicit Sugawara commutator expansion that controls its root and Cartan factors. The noncritical-level coefficient then rules out the proposed leading-term cancellation and forces zero depth, which is the nonroutine obligation behind the selected singular-vector statement.
